Before repeating, test whether the desired next center can be moved to a torus vertex without changing its incidence with earlier centers; if not, stop calling the generic blowup toric and move to a richer ambient representation.
agnostic_oa_blowup_polytope_surgery.source_support: The source says blowing up the projective plane at a point replaces that point by a projective line and depicts this as replacing a triangle vertex by an interval whose length measures the blown-up sphere.
